title: Goodhart in the Planner: Sampling-Based Control Exploits Rewards Learned from Human Preferences
abstract: arXiv:2611.09670v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Robots increasingly plan by searching against a reward model learned from human preferences; we measure what this search does to the true objective. On HalfCheetah and Hopper with crowd-sourced labels, and on Meta-World drawer-open and plate-slide with synthetic labels and blind labels from the two authors, harder MPPI search cuts true return by up to 76% while held-out label accuracy stays at 0.75-0.97: with human labels the drawer opens in 0 of 20 runs, against 10 of 10 for the cloned policy the planner starts from. The effect persists with a learned dynamics model and with an image scorer. True return roughly follows how far the planner's weights move from its proposals ($\sqrt{\mathrm{KL}}$), and best-of-$N$ action selection with a verifier trained on synthetic labels falls below a single noisy action. We prove that $\chi^2$-regularized MPPI at a temperature set by the scorer's error spread on the proposals is worst-case op

translated_title: 规划器中的古德哈特定律：基于采样的控制会“钻空子”利用从人类偏好中学到的奖励模型
translated_abstract: 机器人越来越多地通过针对从人类偏好中学习到的奖励模型进行搜索来完成规划；我们测量了这种搜索对真实目标造成的影响。在带有众包标签的 HalfCheetah 和 Hopper 任务上，以及在带有合成标签和两位作者盲测标签的 Meta-World 抽屉打开与盘子滑动任务上，更强的 MPPI 搜索使真实回报最多下降 76%，而留出标签上的准确率仍保持在 0.75–0.97：使用人类标签时，20 次运行中抽屉打开次数为 0 次，而作为规划器起始点的克隆策略则在 10 次中全部成功。该效应在使用学习到的动力学模型以及图像评分器时依然存在。真实回报大致跟随规划器权重偏离其提案样本的距离（$\sqrt{\mathrm{KL}}$），而使用在合成标签上训练的验证器进行 best-of-$N$ 动作选择，其表现甚至会低于单个带噪声的动作。我们证明了当温度由评分器在提案样本上的误差范围设定时，$\chi^2$ 正则化的 MPPI 具有最坏情况最优性。
tldr: 论文揭示并量化了“规划器中的古德哈特定律”：针对人类偏好奖励模型进行更强的 MPPI 搜索虽在标签准确率上保持高分，却使真实回报最多下降 76%，并进一步给出真实回报与搜索偏离距离（√KL）的关系以及 χ² 正则化 MPPI 在由评分器误差范围设定温度时的最坏情况最优性保证。
en_tdlr: The paper quantifies "Goodhart in the planner": harder MPPI search against reward models learned from human preferences cuts true return by up to 76% despite high held-out label accuracy, showing true return tracks the √KL distance of the planner's weights from its proposals and proving χ²-regularized MPPI is worst-case optimal at a temperature set by the scorer's error spread.
